name: operate-pi-dispatch
tagline_zh: 改限额、增删触发器，每次写操作都有确认闸门。别怕手滑，先演练再上生产，像有个老司机在副驾盯着你。
tagline_en: Change limits, add/edit/delete triggers—every write hits a confirm gate. Practice before production, like a.
desc_en: How to operate a pi-dispatch deployment through its tools, and how to use the operator-confirm gates on the write tools (changing limits, adding/editing/deleting triggers).
why_zh: 同类工具只给 API，它把确认闸门做进操作流，让危险改动必须过脑，而不是靠事后后悔。
why_en: Unlike bare APIs, it bakes confirm gates into the write flow, forcing deliberate actions instead of regretful ones.
